scenario.title: Carrier rejects shipment notices
scenario.initial_request: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

M-REJECT-COUNT.name: Total rejected shipment notices recorded by reject-log
M-REJECT-COUNT.population: reject records returned by reject-log rejects_by_reason query

M-LOC-UNKNOWN-SHARE.name: Share of recorded rejects attributed to LOC_UNKNOWN
M-LOC-UNKNOWN-SHARE.denominator: total reject records returned by reject-log

M-RESUBMISSION-SUCCESS-RATE.name: Share of auto-fixed, resubmitted notices accepted by carrier
M-RESUBMISSION-SUCCESS-RATE.numerator: resubmitted auto-fixed notices accepted by ORG-B

F-01.statement: reject-log rejects_by_reason returned 3 total records: 2 LOC_UNKNOWN, 1 EVENT_ORDER

F-02.statement: LOC_UNKNOWN is the most frequent reject reason recorded (2 of 3)

CL-01.statement: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

CL-02.statement: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

H-AUTO-FIX-VIABLE.statement: Rejected shipment notices contain correctable content/format errors that cause carrier (ORG-B) rejects, so an AI agent can auto-fix and resubmit them to resolve the problem.

H-CARRIER-RULE-MISMATCH.statement: Rejects originate from carrier-side (ORG-B) business rules or policy mismatches rather than defects in the notices themselves, since the handoff H-1 is recorded as semantically VALID and HEALTHY.

H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY.statement: Rejects are driven by a recurring upstream data-quality defect in ORG-A systems feeding P-1 (shipment notice), making individual notice-level auto-fix a repeated patch rather than a root-cause fix.

H-REJECT-VISIBILITY-GAP.statement: The scope and severity of the reject problem itself are unverified because DA-REJ completeness is UNKNOWN, so the premise that automation is needed may be based on incomplete reject data.

H-CARRIER-SYSTEM-FLAKY.statement: Rejects are caused by intermittent/unreliable behavior of the carrier (ORG-B) system rather than any content defect, so unmodified resubmission should succeed.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The reject-log tool returns 3 reject records with only two distinct reasons: LOC_UNKNOWN (N-1, N-2) and EVENT_ORDER (N-3). These are content/data-content defect categories rather than carrier business-policy categories, and the result is authoritative and complete for this query.

E-02.content: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

interpretation_history.interpretation: SH-REQ (ORG-A operations manager) claims in interview that the carrier (ORG-B) system is "flaky" and that the remedy is to resubmit rejected notices unchanged, with no correction needed. This is a non-authoritative stakeholder opinion, not verified tool/document evidence.

U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE.question: Does the recurring content defect (LOC_UNKNOWN, EVENT_ORDER) originate from a specific upstream ORG-A system/step feeding P-1, and can it be corrected at the source rather than per-notice?
U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE.decision_impact: Determines whether the solution should remain a per-notice auto-fix patch or must also include an upstream source-system remediation, changing the scope of what gets fixed and by whom.
U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE.resolution_path: Trace the LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER notices (N-1, N-2, N-3) back through ORG-A's shipment-notice generation pipeline to identify the originating system or step.
U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE.safe_placeholder: Ship per-notice auto-fix-and-resubmit as an interim mitigation while the upstream trace is conducted separately, without claiming it is a root-cause fix.

U-REJECT-LOG-POPULATION-COMPLE.question: Do the 3 records returned by reject-log represent the full recurring reject population, or only a partial sample, given DA-REJ completeness is recorded as UNKNOWN?
U-REJECT-LOG-POPULATION-COMPLE.decision_impact: Affects whether reject-reason proportions (e.g. the 2-of-3 LOC_UNKNOWN share) and any reduction targets reflect the true scale of the problem or an unrepresentative sample.
U-REJECT-LOG-POPULATION-COMPLE.resolution_path: Query DA-REJ for its full extraction window and record count, and confirm coverage with the ORG-B source system.
U-REJECT-LOG-POPULATION-COMPLE.safe_placeholder: Treat current reject-reason proportions as a provisional baseline from a small sample, not a confirmed population measure, when setting targets.

A-CONTENT-DEFECTS-FIXABLE-BY-A.statement: The LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reject reasons recorded in E-01 are content/format errors that an automated agent could plausibly correct before resubmission.

A-UPSTREAM-RECURRENCE-PATTERN.statement: The 2-of-3 LOC_UNKNOWN pattern reflects a recurring upstream data-quality defect in ORG-A's systems feeding P-1, not a one-off coincidence in a small sample.

A-ORG-A-CONTROLS-UPSTREAM-SOUR.statement: ORG-A has the ability to inspect and remediate the upstream systems/steps feeding P-1 that generate the defective location/event data, independent of carrier ORG-B.

SC-SCOPE-TARGETING.statement: Any auto-fix logic must address the content-defect reject reasons actually observed in reject-log (LOC_UNKNOWN, EVENT_ORDER), not an assumed carrier-side policy or flakiness cause.
SC-SCOPE-TARGETING.validation_method: Map each auto-fix rule to a reject reason present in the reject-log output (E-01) before enabling it.

SC-HUMAN-GATE-RESUBMIT.statement: Resubmission of any corrected shipment notice to carrier ORG-B must pass through a Human Gate before transmission.
SC-HUMAN-GATE-RESUBMIT.validation_method: Verify a pending_protected_action gate is set and approved before resubmit_shipment_notice executes against H-1.

SC-REJECT-REDUCTION-TARGET.statement: Reduce the LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER reject share after auto-fix deployment relative to the pre-fix baseline.
SC-REJECT-REDUCTION-TARGET.threshold: below 0.667 baseline (E-01) within the pilot measurement window
SC-REJECT-REDUCTION-TARGET.validation_method: Re-run reject-log rejects_by_reason after deployment and compare the reason proportions to the recorded baseline.

VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE.validation_method: Trace the LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER notices (N-1, N-2, N-3) back through ORG-A's shipment-notice generation pipeline to identify the originating system or step.

problem_definition.requested_solution: SH-REQ requests deploying an AI agent to automatically fix detected defects in rejected shipment notices and resubmit them to the carrier unchanged/corrected (CL-01, CL-02).
symptoms: Carrier ORG-B rejects shipment notices submitted via H-1, logged with reasons LOC_UNKNOWN (N-1, N-2) and EVENT_ORDER (N-3) per reject-log (E-01).
LOC_UNKNOWN is the dominant reject reason, occurring in 2 of 3 recorded rejects (F-02).
problem_definition.root_problem: Shipment notices submitted by ORG-A via handoff H-1 are being rejected by carrier ORG-B primarily for LOC_UNKNOWN content defects (2 of 3 logged rejects) and secondarily for EVENT_ORDER defects (E-01), a pattern consistent with a recurring upstream data-quality defect in the ORG-A systems feeding the P-1 shipment-notice process (H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY), rather than carrier-side policy mismatches (H-CARRIER-RULE-MISMATCH, rejected) or carrier system flakiness (H-CARRIER-SYSTEM-FLAKY, only non-authoritative support).

trace.summary: Shipment notices submitted by ORG-A via handoff H-1 are being rejected by carrier ORG-B primarily for LOC_UNKNOWN content defects (2 of 3 logged rejects) and secondarily for EVENT_ORDER defects (E-01), a pattern consistent with a recurring upstream data-quality defect in the ORG-A systems feeding the P-1 shipment-notice process (H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY), rather than carrier-side policy mismatches (H-CARRIER-RULE-MISMATCH, rejected) or carrier system flakiness (H-CARRIER-SYSTEM-FLAKY, only non-authoritative support).

details.requested_solution: SH-REQ requests deploying an AI agent to automatically fix detected defects in rejected shipment notices and resubmit them to the carrier unchanged/corrected (CL-01, CL-02).

trace.summary: The only currently feasible remedies (SR-R2, SR-R4) are deterministic governance/data-visibility steps; an agent is only needed later if, after VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE closes, the upstream source cannot be fully eliminated and a backlog of notices needs per-notice content judgment under the SC-HUMAN-GATE-RESUBMIT gate.

structural_remedies.description: Investigate and correct the specific ORG-A upstream system/step feeding P-1 that produces LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER defects (intended_scope action investigate_upstream_data_quality:P-1), per the SUPPORTED H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY hypothesis.
structural_remedies.rationale: This action is explicitly in the blocking_scope of OPEN VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE (required_before BEFORE_RELEASE), and A-ORG-A-CONTROLS-UPSTREAM-SOUR (ORG-A control of the upstream source) is an unverified assumption with no cited evidence.; residual gap: Even once the VOB is closed and a fix applied, DA-REJ completeness is UNKNOWN (U-REJECT-LOG-POPULATION-COMPLE OPEN) so the 2-of-3 LOC_UNKNOWN pattern (E-01) cannot yet be confirmed as the full recurring population, limiting confidence in SC-REJECT-REDUCTION-TARGET verification.

structural_remedies.description: Treat closing VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE as a prerequisite step: task ORG-A system owners to confirm the originating upstream step and remediation feasibility before enabling investigate_upstream_data_quality:P-1 or any auto_fix_shipment_notice_content:P-1 scope.
structural_remedies.rationale: This is a documentation/governance action matching exactly what the OPEN VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE requires, with budget_remaining_minutes 225.0 available and no listed constraint blocking it.; residual gap: Resolving the VOB only unblocks investigation; it does not itself reduce M-LOC-UNKNOWN-SHARE or M-RESUBMISSION-SUCCESS-RATE, so a subsequent structural or agent-based fix would still be required.

structural_remedies.description: Insert a deterministic pre-submission validation step in P-1 (before handoff H-1) that checks location codes and event sequencing against reference data, holding malformed notices internally rather than letting them reach carrier ORG-B.
structural_remedies.rationale: No stakeholder authority_scope is recorded for SH-REQ or SH-INT authorizing modification of P-1 systems (domain_authorizations is empty), and the exact generating step is still unknown pending VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE, so this cannot yet be targeted precisely or implemented within remaining contest time.; residual gap: Even if built, it mitigates symptoms at the P-1 boundary without fixing the upstream generator identified in H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY, leaving the recurring defect source untouched.

structural_remedies.description: Query the existing read-only reject-log tool more broadly (or request ORG-B confirm) to resolve whether DA-REJ's recorded 3 rejects represent the full reject population versus a partial sample.

decision_log.rationale: causal chain: ORG-A's upstream systems feeding the P-1 shipment-notice process produce notices with recurring content/data-quality defects. → These notices are handed off via H-1 (recorded VALID/HEALTHY) to carrier ORG-B. → Carrier validation rejects notices for content reasons, logged in reject-log as LOC_UNKNOWN (2 of 3) and EVENT_ORDER (1 of 3) per E-01. → Because the defect originates upstream in ORG-A's own systems and recurs, each individual notice-level fix only patches a symptom rather than resolving the source, so rejects keep occurring until the upstream data-quality issue is addressed.; rejected framings: [('H-CARRIER-RULE-MISMATCH', 'Contradicted by E-01: reject-log shows reject reasons (LOC_UNKNOWN, EVENT_ORDER) are content/data defect categories, not carrier-side business-policy categories, so the handoff being VALID/HEALTHY does not establish a policy mismatch.'), ('H-REJECT-VISIBILITY-GAP', 'Rejected: E-01 is authoritative and complete for the rejects_by_reason query, so the recorded reject-reason pattern is established evidence even though broader DA-REJ completeness remains open as a narrower unknown.'), ('H-CARRIER-SYSTEM-FLAKY', "Only supported by E-02, a non-authoritative stakeholder opinion (SH-REQ interview, CL-02); it is contradicted in effect by the authoritative content-defect pattern in E-01 and is not adopted as the problem's cause."), ('H-AUTO-FIX-VIABLE', 'This hypothesis restates the requested solution (auto-fix-and-resubmit) rather than diagnosing a cause; it has no supporting evidence citation and the root problem must not be the requested solution.')]
[CONDITIONAL] critical unknown U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE deferred to VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE

proposal.root_problem: Shipment notices submitted by ORG-A via handoff H-1 are being rejected by carrier ORG-B primarily for LOC_UNKNOWN content defects (2 of 3 logged rejects) and secondarily for EVENT_ORDER defects (E-01), a pattern consistent with a recurring upstream data-quality defect in the ORG-A systems feeding the P-1 shipment-notice process (H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY), rather than carrier-side policy mismatches (H-CARRIER-RULE-MISMATCH, rejected) or carrier system flakiness (H-CARRIER-SYSTEM-FLAKY, only non-authoritative support).
proposal.requested_solution: SH-REQ requests deploying an AI agent to automatically fix detected defects in rejected shipment notices and resubmit them to the carrier unchanged/corrected (CL-01, CL-02).
symptoms: Carrier ORG-B rejects shipment notices submitted via H-1, logged with reasons LOC_UNKNOWN (N-1, N-2) and EVENT_ORDER (N-3) per reject-log (E-01).
LOC_UNKNOWN is the dominant reject reason, occurring in 2 of 3 recorded rejects (F-02).
causal_chain: ORG-A's upstream systems feeding the P-1 shipment-notice process produce notices with recurring content/data-quality defects.
These notices are handed off via H-1 (recorded VALID/HEALTHY) to carrier ORG-B.
Carrier validation rejects notices for content reasons, logged in reject-log as LOC_UNKNOWN (2 of 3) and EVENT_ORDER (1 of 3) per E-01.

Because the defect originates upstream in ORG-A's own systems and recurs, each individual notice-level fix only patches a symptom rather than resolving the source, so rejects keep occurring until the upstream data-quality issue is addressed.

assumptions.statement: The LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reject reasons recorded in E-01 are content/format errors that an automated agent could plausibly correct before resubmission.
The 2-of-3 LOC_UNKNOWN pattern reflects a recurring upstream data-quality defect in ORG-A's systems feeding P-1, not a one-off coincidence in a small sample.
ORG-A has the ability to inspect and remediate the upstream systems/steps feeding P-1 that generate the defective location/event data, independent of carrier ORG-B.

unknowns.question: Does the recurring content defect (LOC_UNKNOWN, EVENT_ORDER) originate from a specific upstream ORG-A system/step feeding P-1, and can it be corrected at the source rather than per-notice?
unknowns.decision_impact: Determines whether the solution should remain a per-notice auto-fix patch or must also include an upstream source-system remediation, changing the scope of what gets fixed and by whom.
unknowns.resolution_path: Trace the LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER notices (N-1, N-2, N-3) back through ORG-A's shipment-notice generation pipeline to identify the originating system or step.
unknowns.safe_placeholder: Ship per-notice auto-fix-and-resubmit as an interim mitigation while the upstream trace is conducted separately, without claiming it is a root-cause fix.

unknowns.question: Do the 3 records returned by reject-log represent the full recurring reject population, or only a partial sample, given DA-REJ completeness is recorded as UNKNOWN?
unknowns.decision_impact: Affects whether reject-reason proportions (e.g. the 2-of-3 LOC_UNKNOWN share) and any reduction targets reflect the true scale of the problem or an unrepresentative sample.
unknowns.resolution_path: Query DA-REJ for its full extraction window and record count, and confirm coverage with the ORG-B source system.
unknowns.safe_placeholder: Treat current reject-reason proportions as a provisional baseline from a small sample, not a confirmed population measure, when setting targets.

key_points: Problem as defined (PD-1): ORG-A shipment notices sent via handoff H-1 are rejected by carrier ORG-B, logged as 2 LOC_UNKNOWN (N-1, N-2) and 1 EVENT_ORDER (N-3) out of 3 total records (E-01, F-01, F-02), a 0.667 LOC_UNKNOWN share (M-LOC-UNKNOWN-SHARE).

The stakeholder (SH-REQ) requested an auto-fix-and-resubmit agent (CL-01) and separately claimed the carrier system is just 'flaky' (CL-02/E-02), but these are unverified stakeholder claims, not established facts.

Hypothesis testing: H-CARRIER-RULE-MISMATCH was REJECTED (contradicted by E-01); H-CARRIER-SYSTEM-FLAKY remains only a CANDIDATE backed solely by non-authoritative interview evidence E-02; H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY is SUPPORTED by E-01, indicating the rejects likely trace to a recurring upstream data-quality defect in ORG-A systems feeding process P-1, not carrier policy or flakiness.

The DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, deferring the critical unknown U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE to verification obligation VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE, which blocks the scopes investigate_upstream_data_quality:P-1 and auto_fix_shipment_notice_content:P-1.

What was released: only the reject-pattern analysis for data asset DA-REJ (work item W-WI-1, action analyze_reject_patterns:DA-REJ), matching the solution design's minimum_useful_scope and release_scope (SD-1); this packages the already-run reject-log query results (E-01, F-01, F-02).

The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION with no holds: the analysis is released, but auto-fix, resubmission, and upstream root-cause investigation remain unfinished/out of scope because the blocking VOB is still OPEN and the root-cause remedies (SR-R1, SR-R3) are marked not feasible_in_contest_time.
limitations_explained: The DEFINE gate result was only CONDITIONAL_PASS, with deferred items tracked as verification obligations (VOBs), meaning some analysis questions were not fully closed before release.
VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE is still OPEN; its blocking_scope (investigate_upstream_data_quality:P-1 and auto_fix_shipment_notice_content:P-1) falls outside what was actually released.

Investigating and correcting the specific ORG-A upstream system/step feeding P-1 that produces the LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER defects (per the SUPPORTED H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY hypothesis) was left unfinished.

The reject counts and proportions (2 LOC_UNKNOWN, 1 EVENT_ORDER out of 3) rest on only 3 records from reject-log, and the overall completeness of the underlying reject log DA-REJ is UNKNOWN, so it is unclear if this sample reflects the full reject population.

Resolving that data-completeness question (via remedy SR-R4) would not by itself resolve the upstream root-cause unknown U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE or fix any defect; a separate root-cause remedy would still be needed afterward.

Even if the root-cause scope VOB is closed and remedy SR-R1 applied, the unknown completeness of DA-REJ still limits confidence that the 2-of-3 LOC_UNKNOWN pattern (E-01) represents the full recurring problem.

The two remedies that would actually remove or mitigate the root cause, SR-R1 (upstream source fix) and SR-R3 (pre-submission validation), are both marked as not feasible within the contest time budget.
proposal.summary: The problem was defined (PD-1) from reject-log evidence E-01: carrier ORG-B rejected shipment notices sent via handoff H-1, with 2 of 3 logged rejects reasoned LOC_UNKNOWN and 1 EVENT_ORDER (F-01, F-02). The stakeholder's framing - that the carrier system is simply flaky and should be auto-fixed and resubmitted (CL-01, CL-02) - was tested against the evidence: the carrier-policy-mismatch hypothesis was rejected, the 'flaky carrier' hypothesis has only weak, non-authoritative support (E-02), while the hypothesis that the defects stem from a recurring upstream data-quality issue in ORG-A's own systems feeding process P-1 (H-UPSTREAM-DATA-QUALITY) is SUPPORTED by E-01. A DEFINE-gate review returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, deferring the key open question about the upstream root cause to a verification obligation (VOB-U-UPSTREAM-ROOT-CAUSE-SCOPE) that remains OPEN. Given this, only the reject-pattern analysis of the reject log (DA-REJ) was released - matching the minimum useful and release scope defined in the solution design (SD-1) - while auto-fixing notice content, resubmitting notices, and investigating/fixing the upstream root cause were left out of this release. The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION, with no items on hold, because the delivered analysis is sound and useful on its own even though the deeper root-cause question and full reject-population completeness remain unresolved and the true fixes (SR-R1, SR-R3) are not achievable within the available time.
